verses.text: The LORD is near to those who have a broken heart, and saves those who have a crushed spirit.
Blessed are those who mourn, for they shall be comforted.
He will wipe away every tear from their eyes. Death will be no more; neither will there be mourning, nor crying, nor pain any more. The first things have passed away.
For his anger is but for a moment. His favour is for a lifetime. Weeping may stay for the night, but joy comes in the morning.
Therefore you now have sorrow, but I will see you again, and your heart will rejoice, and no one will take your joy away from you.
Why are you in despair, my soul? Why are you disturbed within me? Hope in God! For I shall still praise him, the saving help of my countenance, and my God.
He heals the broken in heart, and binds up their wounds.

Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of mercies and God of all comfort, who comforts us in all our affliction, that we may be able to comfort those who are in any affliction, through the comfort with which we ourselves are comforted by God.
Those who sow in tears will reap in joy.
You count my wanderings. You put my tears into your container. Aren’t they in your book?
Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil, for you are with me. Your rod and your staff, they comfort me.
It is because of the LORD’s loving kindnesses that we are not consumed, because his mercies don’t fail. They are new every morning. Great is your faithfulness.
Peace I leave with you. My peace I give to you; not as the world gives, I give to you. Don’t let your heart be troubled, neither let it be fearful.
Come to me, all you who labour and are heavily burdened, and I will give you rest.
Casting all your worries on him, because he cares for you.
I will be glad and rejoice in your loving kindness, for you have seen my affliction. You have known my soul in adversities.
The righteous cry, and the LORD hears, and delivers them out of all their troubles.
I waited patiently for the LORD. He turned to me, and heard my cry. He brought me up also out of a horrible pit, out of the miry clay. He set my feet on a rock, and gave me a firm place to stand.
God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
Cast your burden on the LORD and he will sustain you. He will never allow the righteous to be moved.
Trust in him at all times, you people. Pour out your heart before him. God is a refuge for us.
My flesh and my heart fails, but God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever.
In the multitude of my thoughts within me, your comforts delight my soul.
This is my comfort in my affliction, for your word has revived me.
When you pass through the waters, I will be with you, and through the rivers, they will not overflow you. When you walk through the fire, you will not be burnt, and flame will not scorch you.
Sing, heavens, and be joyful, earth! Break out into singing, mountains! For the LORD has comforted his people, and will have compassion on his afflicted.
As one whom his mother comforts, so I will comfort you. You will be comforted in Jerusalem.
Then the virgin will rejoice in the dance, the young men and the old together; for I will turn their mourning into joy, and will comfort them, and make them rejoice from their sorrow.
Now may the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that you may abound in hope in the power of the Holy Spirit.
Rejoicing in hope, enduring in troubles, continuing steadfastly in prayer.

Therefore we don’t faint, but though our outward person is decaying, yet our inward person is renewed day by day. For our light affliction, which is for the moment, works for us more and more exceedingly an eternal weight of glory.

In nothing be anxious, but in everything, by prayer and petition with thanksgiving, let your requests be made known to God. And the peace of God, which surpasses all understanding, will guard your hearts and your thoughts in Christ Jesus.
Let’s therefore draw near with boldness to the throne of grace, that we may receive mercy and may find grace for help in time of need.
But you, LORD, are a shield around me, my glory, and the one who lifts up my head.
The LORD, your God, is amongst you, a mighty one who will save. He will rejoice over you with joy. He will calm you in his love. He will rejoice over you with singing.
Put your trust in him, and he will help you. Make your ways straight, and set your hope on him.
You will show me the path of life. In your presence is fullness of joy. In your right hand there are pleasures forever more.
I am still confident of this: I will see the goodness of the LORD in the land of the living. Wait for the LORD. Be strong, and let your heart take courage. Yes, wait for the LORD.
You have turned my mourning into dancing for me. You have removed my sackcloth, and clothed me with gladness.
Why are you in despair, my soul? Why are you disturbed within me? Hope in God! For I shall still praise him: my Saviour, my helper, and my God.
In the day of my trouble I will call on you, for you will answer me.
I will lift up my eyes to the hills. Where does my help come from? My help comes from the LORD, who made heaven and earth.
Jesus wept.
We know that all things work together for good for those who love God, for those who are called according to his purpose.

For I am persuaded that neither death, nor life, nor angels, nor principalities, nor things present, nor things to come, nor powers, nor height, nor depth, nor any other created thing will be able to separate us from God’s love which is in Christ Jesus our Lord.
“Comfort, comfort my people,” says your God.
The LORD is near to all those who call on him, to all who call on him in truth.
Is any amongst you suffering? Let him pray. Is any cheerful? Let him sing praises.
But may the God of all grace, who called you to his eternal glory by Christ Jesus, after you have suffered a little while, perfect, establish, strengthen, and settle you.
He has swallowed up death forever! The Lord GOD will wipe away tears from off all faces. He will take the reproach of his people away from off all the earth, for the LORD has spoken it.

messages.text: Tekiriiko buzibu okuba omunakuwavu leero. Yesu naye yakaaba, era ali kumpi naawe mu maziga go.
Ebiyenge byo tebirina kye bifiiriddwa. Katonda abiraba byonna era abikwata n'obusaasizi.
Tolina kwefuula nga wa maanyi mu maaso ga Katonda. Jjangu gy'ali nga bw'oli.
Okunakuwala ngoye ezizitowa, naye tozambala wekka. Kristo atambulira ku lusegere lwo.
Ekigambo bwe kirema, essaala ennyangu emala: Yesu, nkwesiga.
Mary yali ayimiridde ku mabbali g'omusaalaba. Amanyi ennaku, era akusabira kati.
Okuwulira kuno kwa ddala, naye si lwe luggwa lw'olugero lwo. Katonda akyawandiika.
Kola ekintu kimu ekitono leero. Wummule, olye ku kintu, ossa omukka mpola, era oleke Katonda akwate ebirala byonna.
Mukama ali kumpi n'abo abalina emitima egimenyese. Kino kitegeeza nti ali kumpi naawe mu kiseera kino.
Okwagalwa mu nnaku zo ezisinga obuzibu nga bwe kiri ne mu nnaku zo ennungi.
Weereza omuntu akufaako obubaka bw'engeri gy'owuliramu.
Ne mu kiro mulimu enkomerero. Enkya bulijjo ejja, era n'essanyu lijja kujja.
Leeta ennaku yo eri Ekitukuvu Ekisanyusa. Tuula ne Yesu, nga toliiko kigambo kyonna.
Katonda takwanguyiriza okuwona kwo. Asigala naawe okumala ekiseera kyonna ekikwetaagisa.
Toli muzigo. Oli mwana wa Katonda omwagalwa.
Saba Hail Mary emu mpola, era Maama waffe akukube mu ngoye ze.
Katonda eyakola emmunyeenye amanyi erinnya lyo era afaayo ku mutima gwo.
Okunakuwala kusobola okugonza omutima era ne kuleetawo ekifo ky'okubeeramu kwa Katonda.
Beera mugonvu gy'oli leero, nga Yesu bw'ali omugonvu gy'oli.
Omutima gwo guyinza okuwulira nga gwereere, naye Katonda asobola okugujjuza emirembe ensi gy'etasobola kuwa.
Ebiseera ebimu okukkiriza kuba kusigala mu mbeera. Sigala kumpi ne Katonda, era ajja kukola ekisigaddeyo.
Abatukuvu nabo baali bamanyi ennaku, era baafuna engeri y'okugiyitamu mu kusaba.
Tolina kwetaaga kuba na by'okuddamu. Kyokka olina okunywerera ku Oyo abikola.
Buli kufa kwonna mu bulamu bwo kugobererwa ekisuubizo ky'okuzuukira.
Leero, gamba Katonda kyennyini nga bw'owulira. Ayagala okuwulira ennaku yo ey'amazima okusinga obusirifu bwo.
Tewali nnaku ya maanyi nnyo ekisobola okulemesa okwagala kwa Katonda.
Laba ekirabo ekitono leero: omusana, ekigambo ekirungi, oluyimba. Katonda akweka obubudamu mu bintu ebitono.
Yesu yagamba nti, abasanyufu be abo abakungubaga kubanga bajja kuba bawummuziddwa. Ekisuubizo ekyo ky'ekyo ekikwata ku mmwe.
Emmeeme yo ya muwendo eri Katonda. Teyinza kugikkiriza okufiira mu kizikiza.
Koleeza omuliro gw'ekibiriiti era osabe. Kikujjukize nti ekitangaala ekimu kisobola okugoba ekizikiza.
Osobola okussa omutwe gwo ku mutima gwa Yesu, nga Saint John bwe yakikola mu Kijjulo ekyasembayo.
Katonda tali wala, atulaba. Ajja kumpi era akaaba nammwe.
Okuwona kitera kujja mpola, ng'enjuba bw'evaayo. Weeyongere okwetegereza ekitangaala.
Bw'oba nga tosobola kusaba, saba malayika wo akuweereza okukusabira.
Okunakuwala kwo tekukufuula munafu. Kiraga nti osobola okwagala ennyo.
Ka zabbuli zoogere ku lw'oyo leero. Zirimu buli nneewulira yonna ey'omuntu era zigituusa eri Katonda.
Kristo yaggya obulumi bwo ku musaalaba. Tolina kubwetikka wekka.
Kwata essapule mu mukono gwo, ne bw'oba ng'osaba ekikumi kimu kyokka. Kye kintu ekikulu ennyo.
Olunaku lumu ojja kwejjukanya olabe engeri Katonda gy'akuyisizza mu kino.
Okkirizibwa okukaaba, okuwummula n'okusaba obuyambi. Ekyo si kulemererwa. Ekyo kuba muntu.
Obusaasizi bwa Katonda buli buggya buli lunaku. Enkya erimu entandikwa empya.
Buulira Yesu ekikunyiiza. Awuliriza nga takusalidde musango era ayagala nga talina kkomo.
Omutima gwo gwesigika mu mikono gy'Oyo eyagutonda.
Okunakuwala kuyinza okukujjira, naye tekikufuula ky'oli. Oli wa Katonda.
Laba ku musalaba leero ojjukire: okwagala kusinga, ne bwe kiba nga tekulabika mu kiseera ekyo.
Omwoyo Omutukuvu ayitibwa Omubudaabuzi. Musabe akubudaabuze kati.
Tosobola kwerabirwa. Katonda akubumbye ku mukono gwe.
Leka omuntu akusabire leero. Okukkiriza obuyambi kikolwa kya bukkiriza ekisirikitu.
Enjuba ejja kuddamu okuvaayo, era Katonda ow'okubudaabuda ajja kukusisinkana eyo.
Weerabire mu mazima gano ekiro kino: okwatiddwa, oyagalibwa, era toli wekka.
